sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Marvel of Peru is a tuberous perennial native to Mexico and Central America, often grown as an annual in cold climates. Its branched stems can reach about 1 m.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The opposite leaves are broad and heart-shaped. The fragrant trumpet-shaped flowers open in late afternoon; their colour varies, and the plate shows a magenta form. The dry black fruit is about 7–8 mm long and remains enclosed by the persistent perianth.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: An institutional toxicology source reports a risk from ingestion but does not specify the plant part or dose here. Do not eat the seeds or other parts of the plant.
